reviews.text: David helped us train our rescue shepard, Ralp. I was worried Ralph  would feel scared and abandoned, however, Ralph came back with inner peace and confidence. David also spent time with us working with Ralph and helping to socialize him. I highly recommend training with David.
David is patient with not only the dog but the owner as well. He’s adept at correcting outdated training habits with this owner

David was very patient and attentive with my exceptionally stubborn husky! Some of my main concerns were leash pulling, having no hierarchy established, jumping, getting proper socialization etc. Shep has come back so much more receptive to listening. Our walks are so much more enjoyable! He’s doing great with distractions, and following other commands. David is easy to communicate, with very easy to work with, & is the right guy for the job! He also gave us exercises to practice at home with stay/place etc and Shep is doing very well. Thank you so much, David!
